586-678-5147.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3991-6132-8095.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

141-313-728.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-2438-2842.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4050-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
4050-7804--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7782.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2933-3055-3953-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Drowner of Hope, adding {W}.
When Drowner of Hope dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Drowner of Hope from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Drowner of Hope enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Drowner of Hope.
Repeat.

1849-3259-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
1849-3259-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4321-5777-7313.description:
Activate a Food by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Repeat.

240-4927-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

1453-4559-5147-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-4559-5147-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2308-4716-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4716-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-5524-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-5524-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Destiny Spinner
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

3490-4927-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4927-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3490-5223-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5223-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

141-1269-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1269-2511.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1068-4996-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 6 or higher.
1068-4996-6900.description:
Cast Leveler either from your hand by paying {5} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Leveler enters, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality by paying {5}{W}, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Cast Beacon of Immortality from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
Repeat step 4.
1068-4996-6900.notes: The mana cost and life requirements vary depending on the position of Beacon of Immortality and Leveler. Your life requirement will increase by 5 if Leveler is on top of your library, and the starting mana cost will then be reduced by {5}. The starting mana cost assumes both cards are in your hand. You must have 7 or more life to get infinite lifegain.

1223-2974-4871.description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting Repository Skaab.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, causing it to exploit itself. Pitiless Plunderer, Repository Skaab's second ability and Repository Skaab's ability gained from Fake Your Own Death trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Repository Skaab trigger, returning Fake Your Own Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Repository Skaab trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat from step 3.

1329-1750-2793-5261-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1021-4693-5231-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-4693-5231-6761.description:
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-4693-5231-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

215-1563-4010-4231.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens, two Food tokens, two Clue tokens and two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Foods, two Clues and a Treasures by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-1563-4010-4231.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1020-1117-6518-6709.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-5315.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-5315.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-5070.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-5070.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

618-2438-3991.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token.
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

277-1170-4124-5921-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1809-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Returned Pastcaller each turn.
1809-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Returned Pastcaller by paying its mana cost.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Returned Pastcaller from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4908-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1349-2438-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-2438-6012.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5232-5718-5913.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Pinnacle Monk.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Pinnacle Monk.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Pinnacle Monk.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-2665.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Progenitor Mimic.
1621-2665.description:
Cast Progenitor Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Progenitor Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Progenitor Mimic. Choose to have Progenitor Mimic enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

168-526-4772-5193.manaNeeded: {2}{W}{B}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
168-526-4772-5193.description:
Cast Anikthea from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{W}{B}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring from your graveyard and creating two token copies of it that are 3/3 Zombies.
When the Oblivion Ring tokens enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling Anikthea until the Oblivion Ring token leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the second Oblivion Ring trigger, exiling the first Oblivion Ring token.
When the first Oblivion Ring token is exiled, Anikthea returns to the battlefield from exile.
When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.

654-678-5231-5464.description:
Cast Goldvein Hydra by paying {1}{G}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Goldvein Hydra, adding {R}.
When Goldvein Hydra dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Goldvein Hydra from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goldvein Hydra trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1245-1270.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
1245-1270.description:

Repeat.

1350-3363.description:
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning The One Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat each turn.

613-1623-2125.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
613-1623-2125.description:
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Temporal Extortion and Professor Onyx trigger.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, causing you to pay half your life total, rounded up, and then exile Temporal Extortion and cast it without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2 until your life total is four or less.
Temporal Extortion and Professor Onyx trigger.
Resolve the Professor Onyx trigger, causing you to gain two life and each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, causing you to pay half your life total, rounded up, and then exile Temporal Extortion and cast it without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 5.

479-3304-3513.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in hand.
Your library size is at least sixteen.
479-3304-3513.description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing Impervious Greatwurm, causing you to draw sixteen cards and discard three cards.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Triskaidekaphile triggers, causing you to win the game.

2097-3525-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2097-3525-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

2459-4763-4955-5147.description:
Equip Rograkh with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Rograkh to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Rograkh to you hand.
Cast Rograkh.
Repeat.

3821-4766-5105-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Deathrender attached to Peregrine Drake.
You control lands that produce at least {2}{W}.
3821-4766-5105-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Sigil of the New Dawn and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve Sigil of the New Dawn's trigger, paying {1}{W} to return Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Deathrender's trigger, putting Peregrine Drake from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, untapping up to five lands you control that can produce at least {2}{W}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill four cards.
Repeat.

413-1992-2744.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
413-1992-2744.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
